ex: BARBELL CLEAN AND PRESS mid-clean pull at full extension. The athlete is at the top of the second pull: hips, knees and ankles explosively extended, heels slightly lifted, shoulders shrugged, elbows high pulling the barbell up along the body at roughly chest height, bar close to the torso. Side three-quarter view showing the bar in flight near chest, the triple extension, whole body and both feet.

BARBELL THRUSTER at the drive transition. The athlete is rising powerfully out of a front squat: the barbell is in the front rack position on the shoulders and is being pressed upward, bar just passing forehead/eye level, hips still finishing extension, torso upright. Front three-quarter view showing the front-racked bar mid-press, the upward drive, whole body and both feet.

BARBELL ONE-ARM SNATCH at the overhead lockout. The athlete holds the center of the barbell overhead with ONE fully extended arm, the long bar balanced level in one hand, opposite arm held slightly out to the side for balance, knees and hips slightly bent in the receiving position, head up. Front three-quarter view showing the one-hand overhead bar, the level bar, whole body and both feet.

DUMBBELL ONE-ARM SNATCH at the overhead lockout. The athlete punches one dumbbell straight overhead with the arm fully extended, knees and hips slightly bent in the catch, the other arm free at the side, torso upright. Front three-quarter view showing the locked-out dumbbell overhead, whole body and both feet.

KETTLEBELL ONE-ARM SNATCH at the overhead lockout. The athlete punches one kettlebell straight overhead, arm fully extended, bell resting against the back of the wrist/forearm, knees slightly bent in the catch, free arm held slightly out for balance. Front three-quarter view showing the overhead kettlebell, locked elbow, whole body and both feet.

KETTLEBELL ONE-ARM CLEAN AND JERK at the rack position between the clean and the jerk. The athlete stands tall with one kettlebell racked on the shoulder: elbow tucked close to the body, forearm vertical, bell resting in the crook of the arm, free arm relaxed at the side, chest up, feet about shoulder width. Front three-quarter view showing the racked kettlebell, whole body and both feet.

KETTLEBELL PISTOL SQUAT at the bottom. The athlete squats to full depth on one leg while holding a kettlebell goblet-style at the chest as a counterweight, the free leg extended straight forward just off the floor, supporting heel flat on the ground, torso upright. Front three-quarter view showing the kettlebell at the chest, the extended leg, the deep single-leg squat, whole body.

INCHWORM mid-walkout. The athlete is bent at the hips with legs nearly straight, both hands on the floor well in front of the feet, body forming an inverted V between the flat-backed fold and a high plank, weight on hands and feet only. Side view showing the piked walkout position, straight legs, whole body, hands and feet clearly on the floor.

FLOOR L-SIT hold. The athlete sits on the floor pressing both hands into the ground beside the hips, arms straight, legs held straight out in front raised parallel to the floor so the body forms a clear L shape, toes pointed, shoulders pressed down. Side three-quarter view showing the straight arms, the raised straight legs parallel to the floor, whole body.

TIRE FLIP at the lift moment. The athlete drives a large tractor tire upward off the floor: knees bent in a strong squat stance, chest and shoulder pressed against the tall tire, both hands gripping under the tire's bottom edge, the heavy black tire mid-flip leaning away from the athlete. Side three-quarter view showing the athlete loaded under the tire, whole body and both feet.

ROPE CLIMB mid-ascent. The athlete hangs from a thick climbing rope fixed above, gripping with both hands one above the other, knees bent with the rope wrapped/pinched between the feet for support, body suspended well off the floor, looking up. Side three-quarter view showing the vertical rope, the hand-over-hand grip, the leg wrap, whole body clearly off the ground.

PIKE-TO-COBRA PUSH-UP at the cobra position. The athlete has swept forward and down: hips lowered close to the floor, chest and head lifted high, arms nearly straight supporting the upper body, legs extended behind with thighs near the ground, toes down. Side three-quarter view showing the arched cobra torso, straight arms, whole body.

CRAB TWIST TOE TOUCH at the reach. The athlete is in a crab-walk base, hips lifted off the floor, one hand and both feet supporting, then twists reaching the free hand across the body to touch the toe of the opposite extended leg, torso rotated. Side three-quarter view showing the lifted hips, the reach to the raised foot, whole body.

FLUTTER KICKS on the floor. The athlete lies flat on the back on the floor, head and shoulders slightly raised, hands tucked under the hips, both legs extended straight hovering a few inches off the floor, one leg clearly lifted a little higher than the other mid-flutter. Side view showing the raised head, the alternating straight legs close to the floor, whole body.

RESISTANCE BAND V-UP at the top. The athlete folds into a V-sit on the floor: legs raised straight, torso lifted, both arms reaching forward holding a resistance band stretched taut toward the toes, band visibly under tension between the two hands, balanced on the sit bones. Side view showing the V shape, the taut band, whole body.

VERTICAL LEG RAISE ON PARALLEL DIP BARS at the top. The athlete supports himself on dip bars with arms fully extended, body hanging vertical, legs raised straight out in front to parallel with the floor, toes pointed, shoulders down. Side three-quarter view showing the straight support arms on the bars and the horizontal legs, whole body.

WRIST ROLLER exercise. The athlete stands holding a short wrist-roller bar with both hands straight out in front at shoulder height, palms down; a rope hangs from the middle of the roller with a weight plate suspended near the floor, mid-wind-up. Front three-quarter view showing the extended arms, the roller, the rope and the hanging plate, whole body.

BARBELL DRAG CURL at the top. The athlete stands dragging the barbell up along the front of the body: elbows pulled back behind the torso, bar kept in contact with the body at mid-chest height, shoulders back, underhand grip. Side three-quarter view showing the elbows behind the body and the bar touching the chest, whole body and both feet.

EZ-BAR SPIDER CURL at the top. The athlete lies chest-down on a steep incline bench facing the bench, upper arms hanging vertical below the shoulders, curling an EZ curl bar up with the elbows staying fixed, bar raised toward chin height. Side view showing the prone torso on the incline bench, the vertical upper arms, the curled bar, whole body.

DUMBBELL ONE-ARM KICKBACK at full extension. The athlete hinges forward with a flat back, supporting on the free hand on one knee, the working arm's upper arm held parallel to the torso with the elbow extended straight back, dumbbell lifted behind at shoulder height. Side view showing the flat back, the straightened arm kicked back, whole body.

SISSY SQUAT at the bottom. The athlete leans the torso backward while bending the knees and rising onto the balls of the feet, knees traveling well forward past the toes, body forming a straight diagonal line from knees to head, one hand lightly holding a stable upright post for balance. Side three-quarter view showing the leaning line, bent knees, heels raised, whole body.

SQUAT ON A BOSU BALL at the bottom. The athlete stands balanced on the dome of a BOSU ball (black dome up, flat base on the floor), sunk into a squat with thighs about parallel to the floor, arms reached forward for balance, torso upright. Front three-quarter view showing the domed BOSU under both feet, the squat depth, whole body.

WALKING ON AN ELLIPTICAL CROSS TRAINER. The athlete stands on the moving pedals of an elliptical machine mid-stride, one foot forward and one back, hands on the long moving handles, posture upright, machine fully visible with flywheel housing and rails. Side three-quarter view showing the stride, the handles, whole body and the whole machine.

SKI ERGOMETER pull. The athlete stands at a ski-erg machine pulling both handles down past the thighs: arms extended down, torso hinged slightly forward, knees soft, the machine's two cords running up to the tall fan housing, handles clearly in the hands. Side three-quarter view showing the downward pull, the tall machine, whole body.

WALKING ON AN INCLINE TREADMILL. The athlete walks on a treadmill set to a visible incline, one foot mid-step, upright posture, hands free at the sides not holding the rails, the treadmill belt deck tilted upward and console visible. Side three-quarter view showing the inclined deck, the walking stride, whole body.

WALKING ON A STEPMILL STAIR CLIMBER. The athlete climbs on a revolving stair machine, one foot raised onto a higher step and one foot on a lower step, upright posture, one hand lightly on the handrail, visible staircase steps inside the machine frame. Side three-quarter view showing the steps, the climbing stride, whole body.

PEDALING A STATIONARY EXERCISE BIKE. The athlete sits upright on a stationary bike, hands on the handlebars, one pedal foot down and one knee raised mid-pedal, seat and frame visible. Side three-quarter view showing the cycling posture, the pedals, whole body and the whole bike.

MEDICINE BALL CHEST PASS at the release. The athlete stands in an athletic stance throwing a medicine ball straight forward from the chest: arms extended, ball just leaving the hands in front of the chest, torso leaning slightly forward into the throw. Side three-quarter view showing the ball in flight ahead of the extended hands, whole body.

BALANCE BOARD single-leg stance. The athlete balances on one foot on a round wobble balance board, the board's edge visibly tilted off the floor on one side, the free leg bent and lifted slightly behind, arms held out for balance, eyes forward. Front three-quarter view showing the tilted board under one foot, the single-leg balance, whole body.

SCISSOR JUMP in mid-air switch. The athlete is airborne off the floor with one leg crossed in front of the other mid-scissor, toes pointed down, arms slightly out for balance, clearly above the ground with visible air beneath the feet. Front three-quarter view showing the crossed legs mid-jump, whole body with both feet off the floor.
